claims: The Paradise Season 2 finale is titled "Exodus".
The Paradise Season 2 finale concludes with the destruction of the underground Colorado bunker.
Samantha "Sinatra" Redmond is played by Julianne Nicholson.
Samantha "Sinatra" Redmond has a presumed death in the Paradise Season 2 finale.
Samantha "Sinatra" Redmond sacrifices herself to save the residents during a nuclear meltdown.
Survivors including Xavier are forced to the surface in the Paradise Season 2 finale.
Xavier is played by Sterling K. Brown.
Samantha "Sinatra" Redmond dies in the collapsing bunker.
Xavier is entrusted with a new mission to travel to a second bunker, the Denver Airport, to find the AI "Alex".
The Paradise Season 2 finale features the return of Dylan.
The bunker's population is forced back onto the surface by the "Exodus" Protocol.
Samantha "Sinatra" Redmond entrusts her plans to Xavier.
Samantha "Sinatra" Redmond appears to see an apparition of her son Dylan.
